column1: # Accepted known findings: the aggregate reports these checks as KNOWN and does
# not gate on them. One row per check id, never per test, so anything else the
# test catches still FAILs. Say why it is accepted and who decided, and when.

column4: The runner's private key; the job (same user, with sudo) can read it, and GitHub-hosted has no such file. Accepted as a known finding 2026-10-25: runners are --ephemeral in a per-job container, so the key is good only for the registration of the job that could steal it.
